sloka: गृह्यताम् मागमल्लङ्का मेतद्धि मम रोचते ।ततो राज्ञा समादिष्टाः समुत्पत्य वलीमुखाः ॥६-२०-३२॥।।
transliteration: gṛhyatām māgamallaṅkā metaddhi mama rocate ।tato rājñā samādiṣṭāḥ samutpatya valīmukhāḥ ॥6-20-32॥।।

translations.english: Then having been commanded by the king he caught the forlorn wailing Rakshasa Suka and bound him.
